title: A fish takes a turn
direction: Turn the fish a quarter-turn clockwise and let it grow. Hold for a beat, then return. Repeat every three seconds.
watch: Watch the turn and the change in size happen together.

title: A little lift-off
direction: Let the satellite rise and fade. Pause at the top, then bring it back. Repeat every three seconds.
watch: Watch the satellite lift as its colour fades, then return to where it started.

title: The fading lantern
direction: Lift the lantern until it is almost a ghost. Hold it there, then bring back its colour and position. Repeat every three seconds.
watch: Watch the lantern become faint as it rises. The drawing itself stays the same.

title: A satellite pirouette
direction: Give the satellite a half-turn and make it bigger. Pause, then unwind. Repeat every four seconds.
watch: Watch rotation and growth combine into one looping movement.
